# DotPlotChart

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Dot plot chart that renders circular data points with value labels. Now supports multiple series for comparing datasets. Uses the ICanvas interface for rendering, making it backend-agnostic.

Namespace `BonniePDF`. Extends `CartesianChartBase`.

## Constructors

```csharp
new DotPlotChart()
new DotPlotChart(ChartData data)
```

## Properties

- [`DefaultDotRadius`](#defaultdotradius): Default dot radius for all series (can be overridden per series via Style).
- [`DotColor`](#dotcolor): Color for the data point circles (backward compatibility).
